Connor Murphy  
Senior Mobile Development Lead | Nova Games  
Munich, Germany | +49 157 123 4567 | connor.murphy@novagames.com | linkedin.com/in/connormurphydev  

As a Senior Mobile Development Lead at Nova Games, I specialize in crafting high-performance mobile applications for the gaming industry. My career began as a Mobile Developer Intern at Luminous Studios in 2014, where I gained foundational experience in Android development and iterative feedback loops. Over the past nine years, I’ve evolved from a solo developer to a leader guiding teams through complex mobile ecosystems. At PixelPioneers, I led the development of a cross-platform puzzle game that achieved 150,000 downloads within its first month, optimizing Kotlin-based Android code to reduce cold启动 times by 30%. At GameForge Interactive, I transitioned into a Mobile Architecture Mentor role, refining CI/CD pipelines for React Native projects and implementing Push notifications that boosted user retention by 18% across three flagship titles. My current role at Nova Games involves spearheading the technical vision for our upcoming battle royale game, balancing cross-platform consistency with platform-specific optimizations.  

**Technical Skills**  
My work centers around mobile development with a focus on native and hybrid frameworks. I’ve architected Flutter-based applications for both Android and iOS, leveraging its performance improvements to deliver smooth animations in high-stakes gaming scenarios. TypeScript has been integral to maintaining type safety in large-scale React Native codebases, particularly when integrating with legacy Objective-C systems. Android development remains a cornerstone of my expertise, with a decade of experience refining Kotlin code for real-time multiplayer features in competitive games. On the iOS front, I’ve designed architectures using Swift that scale across multiple devices, ensuring seamless synchronization for cloud-based save systems. Mobile CI/CD pipelines are a critical part of my workflow, having automated 80% of deployment tasks for a game series that ships bi-annually. Push notifications, when implemented with Firebase, have consistently driven user engagement spikes of 12–15% in my projects. App Store deployment is a discipline I’ve mastered through meticulous metadata optimization and compliance audits, with a track record of 98% approval rates for submissions.  

**Projects**  
At Nova Games, I spearheaded the development of *ChronoQuest*, a turn-based strategy game that required cross-platform consistency. By using Flutter for the core logic and Kotlin for Android-specific features, we achieved a 25% faster build time compared to native-only approaches. My work on *TaskFlow*, a productivity app for developers, involved integrating Swift-based iOS features with Flutter’s rendering engine, resulting in a 20% reduction in memory overhead. Both projects benefited from rigorous App Store optimization strategies, including localized descriptions and high-resolution asset pipelines.  

**Education**  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science | University of California, Berkeley | 2015  

**Languages**  
English (native), German (fluent), French (intermediate)  

**Volunteer / Open Source**  
I contribute to open-source projects such as *KotlinUtils*, a library for Android developers, where I refactored deprecated APIs to improve compatibility with Jetpack Compose. I also maintain *FlutterGameSDK*, a toolkit for game developers, adding modular features for monetization and analytics. In my free time, I mentor junior developers at a local coding workshop, focusing on best practices for Swift and Kotlin code structure.
